name: Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2018/848 as regards certain production, labelling and certification rules and certain rules on trade with third countries
part_text:
1. This report sets the European Parliament's position on updating the EU's organic farming rules. It would let the EU organic logo appear on processed food and feed made with imported ingredients, but only if those ingredients meet extra standards. It also makes it easier for small shops and small farmers to avoid certification costs, gives third countries recognised as equivalent more time, and adds rules on online sales, animal welfare and emergencies.

2. What concretely changes:
- EU organic logo allowed on processed goods with imported ingredients meeting extra standards.
- Small retailers and farmer groups get easier exemptions from certification.
- Recognition of equivalent non-EU countries extended to 2031, not 2036.

3. Who it affects:
- Organic farmers, processors, importers, retailers and certifiers across the EU.

4. What happens next:
- Parliament votes in plenary; then talks with EU governments begin.
